organic_results.title: National Health Authority PM-JAY Operational Guidelines - Cashless Access Clause 8.2
organic_results.snippet: Clause 8.2 Cashless Access: An Empanelled Health Care Provider (EHCP) shall under no circumstances charge any fee, advance deposit, or out-of-pocket expenses from the PM-JAY beneficiary for package procedures. Any demand for cash deposit constitutes a material breach of the MoU.

organic_results.title: NHA Anti-Fraud and Grievance Policy - Strict Penalties for Out-of-Pocket Co-payments
organic_results.snippet: Under Section 23 of the PM-JAY MoU, hospitals soliciting cash deposits or directing patients to purchase medicines or consumables privately are subject to instant show-cause notice, penalty interest of 5x the demanded amount, and suspension from empanelment.

organic_results.title: SACHIS Uttar Pradesh Ayushman Grievance Redressal Cell & Toll-Free Helpline
organic_results.snippet: For immediate redressal against empanelled hospital non-compliance, refusal of admission, or illegal deposit demands in Uttar Pradesh, call state toll-free 1800-1800-4444 or national helpline 14555. District Grievance Redressal Committee (DGRC) is headed by CMO Varanasi.

organic_results.title: Central Grievance Redressal Management System (CGRMS) Portal
organic_results.snippet: Beneficiaries can register real-time grievances online at cgrms.pmjay.gov.in or directly with the Hospital Arogya Mitra desk. Statutory resolution turnaround is 48 hours for urgent admission disputes.
